note: Black River floodplain forest on the Arkansas line, with three primitive camping areas in the larger tract, all off County Road 276: one at the small gravel lot where the area road ends, one along that road to the west, and one beside the gravel boat-ramp lot on Cane Creek Ditch at the east end of CR 276. No facilities. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites', three primitive camping areas (page: 'The area includes three primitive camping areas'), free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. The GIS camping points sit 50-80 m into the woods off small gravel lots; PIN in unbroken forest - move ~50 m to the gravel lot. No split (all three within 1.1 km off CR 276). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page: 'The area includes three primitive camping areas, a loop road for access, and a boat ramp'. Map (10/08) shows three primitive-camping symbols, each beside a parking lot: at the end of the gravel area road south of CR 276, at the diamond lot to its NW, and at the boat-ramp lot on Cane Creek Ditch at CR 276's east end. GIS layer 27: 377 (stored pin) 36.50874,-90.47477; 378 at 36.51081,-90.47967 (495 m WNW); 376 at 36.51737,-90.46824 (1.1 km NE). Imagery (leaf-off): none of the three points falls on a clearing - each is 50-80 m into closed bottomland forest from a small gravel lot (lot 634 at the area-road end is roughly 15 m across; lot 631 at the boat ramp is ~40 m gravel apron). Access is on county gravel (CR 269 / CR 276) then the gravel area road - no ford seen. Spots are unmarked and their length unpublished: a 23-ft rig would use the lot edges (caveat in note).

PIN: stored 36.50874,-90.47477 (GIS point 377) is in unbroken forest ~50 m east of the gravel lot at the area-road end. Suggest 36.50894,-90.47529 (MDC parking lot 634, the drivable lot beside it). The roomiest of the three is the boat-ramp lot at 36.51688,-90.46761 (on CR 276 itself) if one pin should stand for the area.

SPLIT: none proposed - the three camping areas are 0.5-1.1 km apart, all reached from CR 276 (the boat-ramp lot at its end, the other two on the area road branching off it); the smaller NE tract (CR 259) has no camping.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed at the pin (no water near the area-road lot). The boat-ramp camping area is beside Cane Creek Ditch (a straight drainage channel ~25 m wide), but its GIS camping point is ~80 m from the bank through woods, and the ramp lot itself is a ramp - no value earned.
PHONE: (573) 290-5730 on the area page matches.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text and the 14-day line dropped; the three camping areas located.
